[9:30 AM] Maya Patel — Project Manager
Good morning, everyone! Let’s finalize the project plan today. Our goal is to launch the redesigned website by 30 September.

[9:38 AM] Maya Patel — Project Manager
Here’s the proposed timeline:

- 27–29 August: Wireframes and content outline
- 30 August–5 September: Visual design and content writing
- 6–18 September: Development
- 19–24 September: Testing and revisions
- 25–29 September: Final review and launch preparation
- 30 September: Website launch

[9:41 AM] Daniel Kim — UI/UX Designer
That timeline works for me. I’ll need the final brand colors, logo files, and image library before starting the high-fidelity designs.
